item.text: {"0":"Replace dot-product scoring with a jointly trained bilinear score s(h,i)=hᵀWe_i, initializing W to identity so initial scores match the baseline. Learning cross-dimension compatibility may improve ranking, especially for Electronics, without changing history readout or item embeddings. Apply the same scorer to positive/negative training logits and prediction, and update the predictor writer to load W. Preserve the causal SASRec backbone, features, loss, optimizer, hyperparameters, seeds and four-dataset routing; train and load exactly one model/checkpoint per category."}
